tools.name: diagnose_response
tools.description: Diagnose a student's written explanation in AP Chemistry or AP Physics 1 (or the same topics in introductory chemistry or algebra-based physics). Returns structured diagnostic data for your own tutoring: the verdict; the student's specific misconception in plain words, with error_source telling you

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Returns Quantabble's coverage and full topic catalog: every schema_id with its course, unit, topic number and title. Use it to check a topic is in scope and to look up the schema_id to pass to diagnose_response when you already know what the student is working on. Free; no model call.
